query:
SELECT 
  title,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(id) as book_ids,
  GROUP_CONCAT(createdAt) as created_dates
FROM books
GROUP BY title, authorId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY count DESC;
